For \(0\le x\le 6\) and \(0\le y\le 7\), the sum \(x+y\) ranges from \(0\) to \(13\).

Counting pairs by sum \(s\):
- For \(0\le s\le 6\), there are \(s+1\) pairs.
- For \(7\le s\le 13\), there are \(14-s\) pairs.

Thus
\[
N(A)=\sum_{s=A}^{13} c_s.
\]
Check from the top:
\[
N(10)=c_{10}+c_{11}+c_{12}+c_{13}=4+3+2+1=10.
\]
So \(N(10)=10\), hence \(A=10\).

\[
\boxed{10}
\]
